messages.text: Which fixes you will pick to the next best build ?

For v8, these are the candidates, in the order I expect them to be ready. A fix joins only once it passes its checks.

| fix | what it does | state |
|---|---|---|
| countdown roll, lighter | the same roll with far fewer animation steps (343 -> 66 per digit) | phone test needs one more short round |
| countdown faces | each digit as 3 ready-made faces, nothing animating while hidden | look checks pass in Chrome and Simulator; write-up next |
| scroll handlers off on phones | skips scroll work that only matters on desktop | first check passed; counts next |
| hero accent word on the GPU | the coloured word in the hero repaints about half as often (1316 -> 688 paints) | looks identical in Chrome; Simulator check next |
| top-bar colour check | less per-frame work deciding the top bar's colour | needs a re-planned test (first one judged the wrong count) |
| fixes for your fast-scroll report | whatever the T-113 checks find in the hero cards and end of page | starts now |

- The two countdown fixes do the same job in different ways. Only the better one goes in, after a side-by-side check.
- Still out: the end-of-page menu animation on the GPU, until we know why its opening frame got slower.
- Each one also gets the new fast-flick check before v8 becomes the best build.

What you need to do: nothing. If one of these matters more to you, tell me and I'll move it up.
Let's do it as highest priority below of Fast flicks stress test
